title: System of Two Linear Equations — Graph
description: Two lines in the xy-plane with their intersection marked, for systems-of-equations questions in the Algebra domain (systems-linear-equations). Stems can ask for the solution, number of solutions, or meaning of the intersection; both lines and the answer derive from the same parameters.

intersectionIsInteger.description: If true, renderer validates that the intersection has integer coordinates within the grid (SAT-clean solution); if false the intersection is left unlabeled.

markIntersection.description: Draw a dot at the intersection. Set false for parallel/coincident-line 'no/infinitely many solutions' items.

labelLines.description: Tag lines near their right ends with line1.label / line2.label.

notes: Renderer guarantees: unit grid and axis arrows; when markIntersection is true the intersection is computed from the two (slope, yIntercept) pairs — never authored separately — so figure and answer key cannot disagree; line labels are placed at opposite ends of the two lines to avoid collision; distinct slopes required when intersectionIsInteger is true.
